neighbours.label: the token ' couple', strongest as the quantifier 'a couple of/more'; other small-quantity words (few, two, pair) stay quiet
fire: The plumber said he would come back in a couple of hours.
We only need a couple more chairs for the guests.
I read a couple of chapters before falling asleep.
Give the soup a couple more minutes on the stove.
There were a couple of mistakes in the final report.
She borrowed a couple of books from the library.
Our neighbors are a friendly couple from Portugal.
He ran a couple of miles along the beach this morning.
quiet: The plumber said he would come back in a few hours.
We only need two more chairs for the guests.

Give the soup a few more minutes on the stove.
There were some mistakes in the final report.

He ran a few miles along the beach this morning.
